arguments.command: export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; mkdir -p "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share"; if [ ! -p "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" ]; then rm -f "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; mkfifo "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; fi; rm -f "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG"; (HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" XDG_DATA_HOME="$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share" nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" > "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/flutter_pid_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}) ; sleep 1; ls -la "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG"; tail -n 5 "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" || true
